answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 164739 Country: India Title: Is it valid to pray namaj after an imam who cut his beard partially but has done tauba and also appologised for the sin he committed? Question: An imam cut his beard partially. After few days, he has done taubah and also apologized to the jamat after one namaz for the sin he has committed. He also stopped leading the namaz for about 40 days. Now his beard is longer than before. Is the namaz praying behind him a valid one? Can we allow him to continue as an imam for a masjid? Answer ID: 164739 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1528/1312/L=01/1440) If imam sahib has repented and his beard has grown one fist or longer as well as the management is satisfied with his taubah then the said person may be appointed on the post of imam again and salah will be valid behind such person. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
